ddl.where: "original_class_id" IS NOT NULL AND "deleted_at" IS NULL
ddl.name: class_instances_original_class_uniq_idx

ddl.value:
("execution_state" != 'COMPLETED' OR "outcome" != 'PENDING') AND
        ("execution_state" != 'NOT_ACTIVATED' OR "actual_start_at" IS NULL) AND
        ("force_activated" = false OR "force_activated_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND
        ("outcome" != 'TAKEN' OR "actual_start_at" IS NOT NULL) AND
        ("is_rate_overridden" = false OR "rate_amount" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: class_instances_state_machine_chk

ddl.value: ("teacher_id" IS NOT NULL AND "student_id" IS NULL) OR ("teacher_id" IS NULL AND "student_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: leave_quota_usage_teacher_student_xor_chk
